title: Game Tracker Live: what's new (Oct 24 - Nov 21)

features.title: Sync devices
features.text: keep your picked games and lit bells the same on your phone and your computer. Open the gear menu, tap Sync devices, then Make a sync link, and open that link on your other devices (on an iPhone Home Screen app, paste it into the same box instead). From then on, add or remove a game or ring a bell on one and the others follow within a second or two. Treat the link like a password: anyone who has it can see and change your games. Stop syncing on any device leaves its games as they are.

features.title: Compact view
features.text: what used to be list view is now small cards, away over home, laid out in columns like the grid. A finished game's Recap sits right under its Final. In both views, cards drop to fewer columns (or stack) before a team name or the down & distance would get cut off.

features.title: Turnover notifications
features.text: interceptions and lost fumbles now send a notification by default, on your phone or your computer, as soon as ESPN logs them. If a score or a turnover gets called back, you get a notification saying so. Red zone notifications are gone; they were more noise than news.

features.title: Save board as image shows the scores
features.text: live and finished games in the picture now show their scores and the clock, laid out like a scorebug.

features.title: Select all for a conference or the Top 25
features.text: while Top 25 or a conference narrows the game list, Select all and Remove all pick or drop just those games.

features.title: Happy Thanksgiving
features.text: through the Sunday after Thanksgiving, the logo and loading spinner are a drumstick with a football for the meat.

features.title: Donate
features.text: the gear menu has a Donate to Save the Children link, going to the Game Tracker Live fundraiser page, which shows what's been raised. The site stays free; this is just a way to chip in for a good cause if you'd like.

fixes: Scores and clocks stay closer to real time when ESPN's scoreboard lags its own play-by-play, and a game shows Final as soon as it ends.
No more Halftime notification at the start of the 2nd quarter.
Light mode: picked games in the game list are plain stripes instead of blue.
Scrolling the game list with your finger no longer leaves a row grey.
Blocked notifications on Android get Android's steps to turn them back on.
The phone gear menu no longer repeats the view and light mode switches.

comingSoon.title: Notification settings per game
comingSoon.text: a sliders button next to a game's bell to choose which notifications that game sends: scores, lead changes, turnovers, turnovers on downs, missed field goals, quarters and more.
